I was born in Russia. My earliest memories are often about me theorycrafting what games could be. I had very limited computer access and a fascination with early sci-fi: Isaac Asimov, Robert Sheckley, Ray Bradbury and Stanisław Lem. When I wasn't reading, I was designing board games and trying to add meta progression to hide and seek.
MOVE OR TAP OUTSIDE TO CLOSE

Huge time skip of me being big sad in school. To fill the void I drowned my sorrow with RPGs by BioWare and Bethesda and small shareware titles. In university I tried to reinvent myself, got an internship at a company making apps, then my first proper job in web development.
MOVE OR TAP OUTSIDE TO CLOSE
SCHOOL, RPGS & FIRST CAREER Life Panel

Leaving the cozy office job was an easy choice after I hadn't been paid for two months in a row. I remembered my childhood aspirations, learned Unity and started getting contracts online. It's been an absolute blast working with people from all over the world, making their dreams come true while also getting paid.

I met a lovely lady who became my wife, rescued seven cats and found new homes for them, and moved to Israel. During that time I also released my own Steam game, survived a drone strike and had two death-defying surgeries — somehow not connected to the drone.

Traditional roguelike set in a unique world. It's a post-post apocalypse adventure where water is currency, ego is magic and cooking is somehow more broken than cybernetics. I want to live in that world.

"Tower of Babel-lite" puzzle game where you are expected to learn a multitude of languages and translate between them.
Mouse over a title to read why it belongs here. Click any row to open its official Steam page.

Would you sell your clone into slavery for 10K dollars? You are now that clone, on the run from the corporation that holds a unique drug needed for your survival. If that's not a gripping premise than what is? Everything is hard choices, dice, risks and plot twists.
Mouse over a title to read why it belongs here. Click any row to open its official Steam page.
A cop with amnesia solving a case. Absolutely peak writing, amazing world, memorable characters. Expect to argue with inanimate objects, debate politics with homeless and face cosmic levels of ennui.
Mouse over a title to read why it belongs here. Click any row to open its official Steam page.

More like sexo one. Pure joy of motion. You are a ball spacecraft that can glide or enable gravity. Despite the simple premise and almost one button controls the skill ceiling is high and the visuals are glorious.
Mouse over a title to read why it belongs here. Click any row to open its official Steam page.

One of the progenitors of modern roguelite genre. Micromanage a spaceship and its crew on a suicide mission to fight a losing war. Make unpopular decisions, gear up, fight and lose horribly time after time. No, targeting their oxygen module to choke them is not a warcrime (I think?).
Mouse over a title to read why it belongs here. Click any row to open its official Steam page.
More like "the sex". A genre blending murder mystery. Expect fourth wall breakage, interesting puzzles and unique mechanics.
Mouse over a title to read why it belongs here. Click any row to open its official Steam page.

Modernized and expanded murder sandbox. Tons of content, tons of replayability, just a fun place to goof around. The approach is varied from surgical sniper shots across the map, to Tom and Jerry style banana peels, to spooky ghost style playthroughs where people just disappear and nobody sees you.
Mouse over a title to read why it belongs here. Click any row to open its official Steam page.

Really fun ragdoll platformer/puzzle hybrid. As a band of merry jellymen go through an open-ish world on an epic adventure. Grab your friend and throw them down a cliff. Not part of the game - just a fun time.

Admin an alternative world virtual reality social network. Ban forbidden gifs, spy on peoples' profiles, customize your desktop with a virtual pet. You have a bad feeling about this...
Mouse over a title to read why it belongs here. Click any row to open its official Steam page.

I love soulslike genre and Korean Pinocchio is somehow the best one. Combining multiple weapons, parrying everything, variety of playstyles and absolutely unforgiving difficulty makes P an easy recommend.

You are getting 3 games for the price of 1. There is a physics based adventure where you kill enemies, get gold and go through levels. There is wand crafting - visual programming allowing you to create custom enemy melting commands. And when you are done gaming and beating the bosses you can wiki it up and learn about working alchemy system, secret parallel worlds and a search for deeper truth.

Time loop, grandiose space vistas and a mystery connecting it all. Stellar world building, environmental storytelling, sound design. One of the greatest pieces of art in modern history is like $3 on sale and you should get it.

Game expects you to break it and if you don't get into breaking the game it will break you. Find spells and chain them together into fun combos like: "turn thing into goop, yeet it forward and then make it come to life".

A unique local PVP FPS where you don't see other players but can pinpoint their location by what they see on their screens. This one you just gotta try.

Spawn in anything using a magic notepad. Use your infinite power to solve minor issues for people around town. Make postman green for no reason, find out how many puzzles can be bruteforced with a gun. DO NOT MAKE YOURSELF EDIBLE.

A deconstruction of player agency and games in general. Really fun writing, nice variety of choices and lots to think about.

Voxel based physics sandbox where given an array of tools you have to plan out and execute some time sensitive heists. Rube Goldberg your way through robberies, "controlled" demolitions and amateur racing. Haven't tried the DLCs but the base game is a must play.

Commonly referred to as "2D Minecraft" it's actually so much more. Summon demons, go to space with a potion, use every material for building (cactus toilet, walls made out of rain, flesh floor). Bored? Wait half a year for an update doubling the content.

And other games from the studio. Amazing text adventure with simple combat and surprisingly deep world for a game where you can be a bean wizard. Hope you like reading, because every sentence is pure gold.
